ev.q: On April 8, 2021, a newborn was delivered at 24 weeks’ gestation with congenital varicella syndrome
At delivery, the newborn had a heart rate of 60 beats/minute, an Apgar score of 1, and weighed 526 g
This is the third reported case of congenital varicella syndrome in the United States since the varicella vaccination program started in 1995
Notes from the Field: Congenital Varicella Syndrome Case — Illinois, 2021
After birth, neither additional VZV testing nor an autopsy was performed.
